note: The Maldives Islamic Bank's list of bank charges (version 5.8, effective 24 September 2026): keeping a current or savings account is free in rufiyaa and in dollars; only an account dormant for 24 months is charged (50 rufiyaa a month), which the game doesn't count. The Bank of Maldives' own charges sit behind a bot check and weren't read.

sources.title: Maldives Islamic Bank, List of Bank Charges (version 5.8, effective 24 September 2026)
sources.said: VERSION 5.8 EFFECTIVE FROM 24TH SEPTEMBER 2026 ... ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE FREE FREE ... DORMANT ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE FEE (Per month)¹ 50 3 ... 1. Dormant accounts are accounts which have not experienced any activity from the customer or a depositor over a period of 24 months.
